provenance: Special Metals INCONEL alloy 625 bulletin (publication SMC-063) -- Balbaa2022 reference [63], cited by him for the temperature-dependent mechanical properties of the stress model. Transcribed 2026-07-30 from the repo copy cases/AM-Benchmark/references/material/SpecialMetals_INCONEL-alloy-625_bulletin.pdf (p.2 Tables 2-3, p.3 Table 4).
quarantine_note: This source is legitimate for V2 because Balbaa cites it (unlike the Kaschnitz IJT companion, rejected in D-V2-04). The SAME file is also a main-case source; that is a shared PUBLIC reference, not a leak of main-case derived inputs -- V2 transcribes it independently here and consumes only these rows.

table4_modulus_elevated_temperature.provenance: Special Metals Table 4, p.3; footnote a: determined dynamically on samples from 3/4-in hot-rolled rod
table4_modulus_elevated_temperature.note: table stops at 871 C; the solidus is 1290 C -> high-T extrapolation required (D-V2-17)

table3_mean_linear_expansion.provenance: Special Metals Table 3, p.2; footnote a: MEAN linear expansion FROM 70 F (21 C) TO THE TEMPERATURE SHOWN
table3_mean_linear_expansion.kind: mean (secant) coefficient, NOT instantaneous -- see D-V2-18

table3_thermal_conductivity_annealed.provenance: Special Metals Table 3, p.2; footnote b: measurements at Battelle Memorial Institute; footnote c: material annealed 2100 F / 1 h
table3_thermal_conductivity_annealed.v2_usage: NOT used -- V2 keeps V1's Balbaa-as-printed thermal reconstruction (Table 1 range endpoints) for parity. Transcribed only as a cross-check: Balbaa's printed 10.1-31.6 W/mK range brackets this measured curve at the low end (10.1 at 38 C) but exceeds it at high T.

table2_physical_constants.v2_usage: cross-check only; the 1290 C solidus that both Balbaa and Lane use as the melt-pool boundary is this datasheet's melting-range lower bound

balbaa_modulus_reconstruction.what: Balbaa2022 p.33: 'since the measured Young's modulus is lower than its values reported in the literature, the newly measured value was used ... Young's modulus data from the literature were offset by the difference between measured to obtain its values at high temperature' (measured as-built LPBF IN625: E = 171 GPa at RT).
balbaa_modulus_reconstruction.consequence: his E(T) curve (his Fig 41) is RECONSTRUCTIBLE ARITHMETICALLY -- no figure digitization needed: E_balbaa(T) = E_SpecialMetals(T) + (171 - E_SpecialMetals(RT)).
balbaa_modulus_reconstruction.adopted: annealed branch (offset -36.5 GPa); the datasheet's k/cp rows Balbaa's Table 1 range brackets are the annealed ones too
balbaa_modulus_reconstruction.status: to be verified against a digitization of his Fig 41 before the RS gate (D-V2-03)
